 *****
Sudhir Mittal, J. (Oral)

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.88 dated 17.02.2020, registered at Police Station Bhiwani Civil Lines, District Bhiwani, under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 IPC on the basis of compromise.

Pursuant to order dated 04.03.2020, report dated 14.07.2020 has been received from the Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bhiwani, according to which, the statements of the parties have been recorded and the compromise is genuine and has been arrived at between them without any threat, pressure or coercion.
In view of the above, the petition is allowed.

FIR No.88 dated 17.02.2020, registered at Police Station Bhiwani Civil Lines, District Bhiwani, under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 IPC alongwith all consequential proceedings having arisen therefrom, is quashed qua the petitioner.

(SUDHIR MITTAL)
